source:
@@U01946@@
Be nice to them, if only for my sake; it’s little trouble and great fun. But what’s that racket of instruments I hear? Blasted noise! Just have to get used to it, I guess. Come, come along now! Youve no choice. Let’s go in. I'll make the introductions, and, doing so, put you in my debt a soupgon deeper. What do you say to that, my friend? Look! No small space, this! You can hardly see to the end. A hundred bonfires blazing in a row! And dancing, and chatter, and drinking, cooking, making love! I ask you now, what could be better?

@@U01948@@
When you introduce me, what role will you be playing, sorcerer or Devil?

@@U01950@@
I'm likeliest to go incognito, though on gala days one can show one’s decorations. Unfortunately, I haven't a garter to distinguish me, but my horse’s hoof garners high honor here. Do you see that snail crawling this way? With her groping face she’s already sniffed out something special in me. I couldn't deny my identity here if I wanted to. Come!
translation:
@@U01946@@
善待他们，哪怕只是为了我；这没什么麻烦，但又很有趣。但我听到的乐器喧闹声是什么？爆炸声！我想，只是需要习惯而已。来吧，快来吧！你别无选择。我们进去吧。我会做一些介绍，这样做会让你更感激我。我的朋友，你对此有何看法？看！空间不小啊，这个！你很难看到最后。一百个篝火连续燃烧！还有跳舞、聊天、喝酒、做饭、做爱！我现在问你，还有什么更好的吗？

@@U01948@@
当你介绍我时，你会扮演什么角色，巫师还是魔鬼？

@@U01950@@
我最有可能隐姓埋名，尽管在节庆日人们可以展示自己的装饰品。不幸的是，我没有吊袜带来区分我，但我的马蹄在这里获得了崇高的荣誉。你看到那只蜗牛这样爬行吗？从她那张摸索的脸，她已经嗅出了我身上的一些特别的东西。如果我愿意的话，我无法否认自己在这里的身份。来！
